name: Shenzhen Bingchuan Network Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Bingchuan Network Co.,Ltd. operates as an online gaming company in China and internationally. The company engages in technology development, technical consulting, and sale of computer hardware and software; research, development, and operation of online games; animation design; industrial and project investment activities; venture capital; and data processing. It also provides digital cultural and creative content application services and software development; big data services; internet data services; and information technology consulting services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
